description: As we leave behind a sweltering summer and face climate change going forward, we must ask ourselves how we can live more sustainably and comfortably in the decades to come. This walking tour explores a variety of architectural design responses to this question - from net-zero homes and natural material, to cohesive and sustainable communities.

events.name: Pioneering sustainable design for a changing climate

factsheet.heading: Sustainable Design in the Built Environment
paragraphs: Architecture can be a powerful tool to address the issue of climate change. Be it through insulating our homes, installing double-glazed windows and implementing heat pumps to use renewable energy sources, to using natural materials or climate-adaptive design strategies, our buildings and neighbourhoods can be designed to be pioneers of sustainability for future generations.
